The NCES 10-year follow-up found that children who had had a serious acute neurological illness (excluding infantile spasms) had an increased risk of death or long-term dysfunction, but the risk was no greater in children given DTP vaccine in the 7 days before the original acute illness.9 The National Vaccines Adviso- ry Committee concluded that the results were insufficient to de- termine whether DTP vaccine influenced the development of chronic neurological dysfunction, and this conclusion has been accepted by both the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices12 and the American Academy of Pediatrics.13 1.
